processing: Seventeen cues for one catch (doc 42, Fishing): three swings of a bamboo rod for the cast; three pebbles falling into a pond as foley for the float landing (not a recorded float); three splashes of a real fish at the surface for the bite; three of a fish splashing as it is released for the landing (a fish going back in stands for one coming out), and two longer stretches of a fish jumping for a Ranger's big fish; three single flops of a fish on land for the caught fish flapping. Each variant is a separate recorded event. Cropped to start on the event, DC removed, gently high- and low-pass filtered (zero phase), edge-faded and set to the level below subject to its peak ceiling. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, added reverberation or denoising. Two cues sit lower than their kind's common level so the variants are heard alike: fish_bite_02 by its peak ceiling, fish_land_03 (the one full-band landing) by its target. Runtime cosmetic pitch variation remains.
